intro.speaker: slime
intro.text:
员工，别盯钟了。
下班前顺手接个需求。
intro.english:
Contractor, stop staring at the clock.
Just one quick task before you leave.

intro.speaker: hero
intro.text:
17:29了。你这个“顺手”，
是不是要顺到明天？
intro.english:
It is 17:29. Does your quick task
come with a complimentary tomorrow?

intro.speaker: slime
intro.text:
外包仔，需求只有亿点点。
来，碰我一下就算你签收。
intro.english:
Contractor, it is only a tiny billion tasks.
Touch me and you accept the assignment.

intro.speaker: hero
intro.text: 那我这双腿，今天就是拒收键。
intro.english: Then these legs are my reject button.

caught.speaker: slime
caught.text:
跑得挺快啊，外包仔。
需求已签收，今晚辛苦一下。
caught.english:
Nice sprint, contractor.
Task accepted. Enjoy your evening shift.

caught.speaker: hero
caught.text:
我只是碰了你一下！
这也能算签收？！
caught.english:
I only bumped into you!
That counts as an electronic signature?!
